title: New Country
description: Detects sign-ins from new countries. The detection considers past activity locations to determine new and infrequent locations.
author: Mark Morowczynski '@markmorow', Gloria Lee, '@gleeiamglo'
falsepositives: We recommend investigating the sessions flagged by this detection in the context of other sign-ins from the user.
